# Reliance Terms of Use

## 1. Who operates Reliance

Reliance Technologies LLC ("Reliance," "we," "us," or "our") operates the Reliance platform. Questions about these Terms or Reliance may be sent to `Relianceorg.support@gmail.com`. This email address is not represented as a physical office, registered office, registered-agent address, or an address that is sufficient for every form of statutory or legal notice.

## 2. What Reliance does

Reliance provides software that helps Customers, Vendors, Vendor Managers, assigned service professionals, and Reliance administrators coordinate service records and, when authorized, create and manage Service Videos and related evidence. Reliance may provide Private Proof, customer reviews, Favorites, reporting, Public visibility controls, notifications, and administrative audit tools.

Reliance is a technology platform. Unless Reliance separately agrees in writing, Reliance is not the Vendor that performs the underlying service and does not certify workmanship, safety, code compliance, licensure, insurance, or professional quality. Vendors remain responsible for their services, personnel, representations, and legal obligations.

## 3. Eligibility and authority

You must be legally able to use the platform and provide the decisions you submit. You may act only for yourself or for an organization you are authorized to represent. A Vendor representative must not accept terms, recording participation, or Public participation for an Employee. A Customer must not authorize an Employee's personal recording participation. An Employee must not authorize another Employee.

If you receive a request that is not for you or that you are not authorized to answer, use the available correction path or contact Reliance. Do not accept on another person's behalf.

## 4. Accounts, links, and verification

You are responsible for protecting your credentials and devices. Some Employee experiences use a Service Order link as an entry credential followed by server verification, such as a one-time code or verified decision session. A link may expire, be revoked, or become stale after reassignment or a recording-scope change.

Do not share passwords, one-time codes, signed links, or bearer credentials. Notify Reliance promptly if you believe access has been compromised.

## 5. Role-specific terms and electronic records

General acceptance of these Terms is not a substitute for a role-specific decision. Reliance may require a Vendor, accountless Employee, Customer, or other actor to review and affirm a separate exact version of applicable terms, notices, or consent language.

When Reliance presents an electronic acceptance or decision, Reliance identifies the document or decision and provides access to a durable copy when required. Material changes use a new version and require fresh affirmative assent when applicable. Continued use alone does not authorize a materially changed consent proposition.

## 6. Service Records and Service Videos

A Service Record may contain service details, lifecycle history, assignment information, evidence, reviews, reports, and an exact three-stage Service Video package: Starting Condition, Work in Progress, and Final Result. The complete package remains the unit of customer-controlled visibility under the current product model.

Service Video evidence is not a guarantee that every event, condition, or statement was captured. Users must not alter, mislabel, impersonate, or submit misleading evidence.

## 7. Recording authorization and participation

Recording is permitted only when Reliance's current server-side requirements are satisfied. Customer Recording Authorization, each required Employee's job-specific Recording Participation, stage-specific location and safety evidence, current assignment and assessment context, and other applicable gates remain separate requirements.

Recording authorization does not authorize Public use. Employee job-specific Recording Participation is not standing Public participation. Customer authorization to make a finished package Public is a separate later choice.

Users must stop or avoid capture when unauthorized people, minors, bystanders, unrelated private conversations, private documents, credentials, access codes, or security information could be recorded. Audio recording must not proceed unless all legally required parties have authorized it. Reliance may apply a conservative all-required-parties rule when jurisdiction or party location is uncertain.

## 8. Public and Private visibility

An approved Service Video is Private by default. If the exact package is eligible and all current participant permissions and restrictions permit, the owning Customer may separately choose Share Publicly. A Public package may be viewed, heard, copied, downloaded, recorded, or redistributed by people outside Reliance's control. Reliance cannot guarantee removal of copies made outside its systems.

The owning Customer may later choose Make Private. Reliance stops new Public access through its controlled surfaces after a successful server transaction, but outside copies may remain. Historical authorization and visibility evidence is preserved.

## 9. Customer reviews and Favorites

A customer review is the Customer's rating or written review of a Vendor or service. It is separate from Reliance Audit and Public visibility. Reviews must reflect the Customer's genuine experience and must not contain unlawful, threatening, deceptive, or irrelevant content. Optional Employee ratings remain separate from Vendor ratings and do not automatically affect Reliance Trust Score.

Favorites are organizational preferences. Saving or removing a Favorite does not certify, endorse, hire, or contract with a Vendor.

## 10. Reports, disputes, and safety holds

Users may report a problem with content or request support. Reliance may restrict Public visibility or take other proportionate protective action while a report or dispute is reviewed. A report is not itself a final finding. Reliance may preserve relevant evidence and an audit trail.

## 11. Acceptable use

You must not:

- use Reliance unlawfully or to violate another person's rights;
- record, upload, disclose, or publish content without required authority;
- impersonate another person or submit a decision for them;
- bypass identity, assignment, consent, safety, location, audit, or visibility controls;
- upload malware or interfere with platform security or availability;
- scrape, harvest, or use personal data outside an authorized purpose;
- falsify Service Records, evidence, reviews, reports, or credentials; or
- use Reliance to harass, discriminate, retaliate, or coerce a person for declining optional recording or Public participation.

## 12. User content and licenses

As between you and Reliance, you retain any ownership rights you have in content you submit. You grant Reliance a limited, nonexclusive license to host, store, reproduce, process, transmit, display, and make technical copies of that content only as reasonably needed to provide, operate, secure, audit, maintain, and support the Reliance features you are authorized to use; comply with law; enforce these Terms; and honor the visibility choices and permissions that apply to the content.

This license does not authorize Reliance to sell your Service Video or other user content, use it for unrelated advertising or promotional exploitation, or use it for general-purpose model training unrelated to providing the authorized Reliance service. It does not itself authorize Public display. Public display requires the applicable exact-package Customer choice, participant permissions, audit eligibility, and current server-side authorization.

Reliance uses third-party providers for some platform functions. Provider-specific processing is governed by the applicable service configuration and provider terms; Reliance does not make a provider-specific promise unless that commitment has been verified for the configured service.

## 13. Reliance content and software

Reliance and its licensors retain rights in the platform, software, branding, and platform-authored materials. Subject to these Terms, Reliance grants you a limited, revocable, nontransferable right to use the platform for its intended purpose. You may not copy, reverse engineer, or exploit the platform except where applicable law does not permit that restriction.

## 14. Third-party services

Reliance uses service providers for functions such as cloud hosting, storage, databases, maps or geocoding, identity and authentication, email and optional transactional messaging, security, and AI-assisted features. Their availability and terms may affect parts of the service.

## 15. AI-assisted features

Reliance may use AI-assisted tools to summarize, organize, flag, or help a human review information. AI output can be incomplete or wrong. AI does not make the final Reliance Audit, consent, Public-visibility, report, employment, workmanship, licensure, code-compliance, or legal decision. Authorized people remain responsible for consequential decisions. Do not rely on AI output as legal, safety, or professional advice.

## 16. Availability and changes

Reliance may maintain, change, suspend, or discontinue features. We do not promise uninterrupted or error-free operation. Reliance uses reasonable care to preserve evidence and communicate material changes consistent with applicable product and legal requirements. A material change to a consent or assent proposition uses a new version and fresh acceptance when required.

## 17. Disclaimers

To the extent permitted by law, Reliance is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis. Reliance disclaims implied warranties to the extent they may lawfully be disclaimed. Nothing in these Terms excludes a warranty, remedy, duty, or right that cannot be excluded under applicable law.

Reliance does not warrant that a Service Video proves the quality, legality, completeness, or safety of the underlying work. Reliance does not guarantee that a Vendor or Customer will complete a transaction or that content made Public will not be copied outside Reliance.

## 18. Responsibility and remedies

Each party remains responsible for its own conduct and legal obligations. Nothing in these Terms limits a remedy or right that cannot lawfully be limited. These Terms do not require mandatory arbitration, waive participation in a class action, create a broad user indemnity, or establish a general liability cap.

## 19. Governing law and disputes

These Terms are governed by Florida law, without regard to conflict-of-law principles, except where nonwaivable law provides otherwise. Before litigation, a user may contact Reliance at `Relianceorg.support@gmail.com` so the parties can attempt an informal resolution. Nothing in this section waives a nonwaivable right, forum, remedy, agency process, or consumer protection.

## 20. Termination, survival, and contact

You may stop using Reliance. Reliance may restrict or terminate access for security, unlawful use, material breach, or platform protection, subject to applicable law and evidence-preservation duties. Provisions that by their nature should survive, including evidence integrity, licenses needed to preserve authorized records, ownership, disputes, and nonwaivable rights, continue as appropriate.

Questions, privacy requests, withdrawal requests, and disputes may be directed to `Relianceorg.support@gmail.com`. Identity and authority verification may be required before Reliance acts on a request.

# Reliance Transactional SMS Notice

If you separately choose an available text-message option, Reliance Technologies LLC may send transactional messages about actions or records associated with your Reliance relationship. Examples include a verification code, Service Order delivery or status, account security, appointment or workflow notice, support response, or another message needed to complete a request you initiated.

Reliance does not use this consent for marketing or promotional texts. Consent to transactional SMS is optional and is not a condition of purchasing services, opening an account, accepting an assignment, or using an available email alternative.

## Opt in

**Checkbox:** I agree to receive automated transactional text messages from Reliance at the mobile number shown for verification, security, Service Order, support, and workflow notices. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Consent is optional. Reply STOP to stop and HELP for help.

**Button:** Enable Text Messages

## Confirmation

Reliance transactional text messages are enabled for the verified number ending in the digits shown. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to stop and HELP for help. Email or another available channel remains available where the product supports it.

## STOP response

You have opted out of Reliance transactional text messages to this number. No additional texts will be sent except a confirmation or messages permitted by law. Use email or contact Relianceorg.support@gmail.com for help.

## HELP response

Reliance transactional message help: visit the Reliance support surface or email Relianceorg.support@gmail.com. Message and data rates may apply. Reply STOP to stop.

## Delivery and security

Carriers and messaging providers are not controlled by Reliance, and delivery is not guaranteed. Do not send passwords, signed links, or other credentials by text.

# Vendor Organization Agreement

## Vendor responsibilities and Reliance platform terms

You are accepting for the Vendor organization identified on this screen. By continuing, you confirm that you are authorized to bind that organization to the version shown and to receive this record electronically.

I confirm that:

1. I have authority to act for the identified Vendor organization.
2. The Vendor is responsible for the services it performs, its personnel, required licenses and insurance, workplace obligations, and the truthfulness of information it submits.
3. Reliance is a technology platform and does not certify workmanship, job-site safety, code compliance, licensure, or professional quality.
4. The Vendor will assign only the correct current Employee or service professional and will keep contact and assignment information accurate.
5. The Vendor will not accept or decline recording participation or standing Public participation for an Employee, and will not make a Customer's recording or Public-visibility choice.
6. The Vendor will not retaliate against, coerce, or misrepresent the decision of an Employee who declines optional Reliance recording or optional standing Public participation.
7. The Vendor will use the current Service Order and reassignment or scope-replacement process. A stale link, prior assignment, prior assessment, or prior Employee decision cannot authorize a current context.
8. The Vendor will not direct recording of minors, unrelated adults, bystanders, private conversations, private documents or screens, credentials, access codes, or security information.
9. Audio may be recorded only when the current scope includes audio and all legally required parties have authorized it.
10. The Vendor will use Reliance reports, reviews, Public controls, and evidence only for legitimate platform purposes and will not falsify or suppress evidence.
11. The Vendor has reviewed the linked Terms and Privacy Notice and can retain a copy of the exact versions shown.

# Before you use this Service Order

The Vendor shown on this Service Order identified you as the assigned service professional for this Work Record. Reliance Technologies LLC provides the Service Order and, when separately authorized, the recording workflow. This page is for your own verified Employee context. Do not use another person's link or make a decision for someone else.

By affirmatively agreeing, you acknowledge that:

1. You may use the current Service Order only for the assigned Work Record and Vendor shown.
2. The Service Order link is an entry credential and may require a one-time verification step. It may expire or become stale after reassignment or scope replacement.
3. You will protect the link, one-time code, and verified session and will not share them.
4. Reliance may process the minimum identity, Vendor membership, assignment, Service Order, security, and evidence information needed to verify your access and operate the workflow.
5. Any job-specific Recording Participation choice is separate and will be presented before recording. Accepting this accountless notice does not allow recording.
6. Standing Public Service Video Participation is also separate and optional. It is not required to open a Service Order or perform Private Proof work.
7. A Vendor or Manager cannot accept, decline, or override your personal recording or standing Public choice.
8. Reliance recording authorization does not certify workmanship, job-site safety, licensure, code compliance, or employment status.
9. You must stop or avoid recording if a minor, unrelated adult, bystander, private conversation, private document or screen, credential, access code, or security information could be captured.
10. You have access to the linked Terms and Privacy Notice and can retain a copy of the exact versions shown.

**Button:** This Service Order is not for me

Use this when the link was sent to the wrong person or you are not the assigned person. It is an identity or assignment correction, not a refusal to participate in recording and not acceptance of any term.
